topic_title: Value of Responsible Reduced-Risk Driving Practices
prompt: According to Texas traffic safety data, what percentage of motor vehicle crashes are caused by human driver error?

options.text: Less than ten percent of crashes involve human judgment or driving mistakes
Over ninety percent of crashes result directly from driver behavioral error
Crashes are caused almost exclusively by mechanical engine component failures
Unpredictable planetary weather patterns cause eighty percent of highway crashes
